related.description: ZSH plugin that automagically detects and activates your python environments (poetry, virtualenv, conda) while traversing directories.
Just a tiny little plugin for OMZ or whatever for use with conda setups
A Zsh plugin that automatically activates the Python virtual environment in the current directory or its parent directories.
☣️ Shell plugin for zsh/bash that allows you to cd to subdirectories of user-defined directories from anywhere, without editing CDPATH.
Oh-my-zsh plugin to automatically load or unload environment variables from .envrc file depending on the current directory.
